companyFieldUpdates.description: Arlington Industries manufactures electrical fittings, connectors, boxes, enclosures, cable-management, grounding, communications, security and audio-visual products for electrical distributors and contractors serving commercial, industrial, data-center, communications and building applications. The company operates from a seven-acre manufacturing base in Scranton, Pennsylvania, with regional distribution in the United States and Canada, and reported more than 350 North American patents or applications in its 2024 company history. Blackstone Energy Transition Partners announced an acquisition agreement on January 26, 2026; the FTC identifies Blackstone Energy Transition Partners IV AIV L.P. as the acquirer, and Blackstone's second-quarter 2026 results report Arlington within capital deployed. The exact closing date, stake and any Stark-family rollover are not publicly disclosed. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
